aland-law holds 1 of the 690 consolidated texts in Ålex: Landskapslag (2015:68) om hemvårdsstöd, with 7 replayed amendments and an end state that matches Ålex word for word. The Autonomy Act is held only in finland-law, in Finnish and as current text only. The Lagtingsordning, the main landskapslagar and Ålands förvaltningsdomstol's case law are not held anywhere.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
